title: Multi-Vendor Commerce REST API Platform — Capstone
objective: Design and implement a production-oriented commerce API where customers browse products, suppliers manage inventory, and orders follow a controlled lifecycle.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Customer and supplier identity, profiles, and access control
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate customer and supplier identity, profiles, and access control in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Products, categories, variants, inventory, search, and pagination
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate products, categories, variants, inventory, search, and pagination in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Server-side cart and order totals with transaction-safe inventory checks
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate server-side cart and order totals with transaction-safe inventory checks in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Payment sandbox/mock integration, signed webhook verification, and duplicate-event protection
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate payment sandbox/mock integration, signed webhook verification, and duplicate-event protection in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 5: Tenant-aware authorization, OpenAPI contracts, automated tests, observability, and recovery documentation
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate tenant-aware authorization, openapi contracts, automated tests, observability, and recovery documentation in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Customer and supplier identity, profiles, and access control
Products, categories, variants, inventory, search, and pagination
Server-side cart and order totals with transaction-safe inventory checks
Payment sandbox/mock integration, signed webhook verification, and duplicate-event protection
Tenant-aware authorization, OpenAPI contracts, automated tests, observability, and recovery documentation
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
